project.name: astro-science
project.description: Scientific research workspace producing an astrophysics portfolio; the domain graph captures its operating loops: data refresh, notebook health, research & theory, knowledge-graph maintenance, and the deterministic graph-drift check that queues refreshes.

nodes.name: Observational Data Refresh
nodes.summary: Keeps every observational catalog in the workspace current: GWOSC/GWTC merger events, HEASARC compact-object catalogs (XRB, M87, Sgr A* region, ULX), BlackCAT dynamical black-hole masses, EHT/Gaia/Planck/SDSS/SXS auxiliary sources, and the derived processed CSVs the notebooks and dashboards consume.

businessRules: Catalog snapshots replace rather than merge: back up before re-running update_gwosc.py
Catalog measurements carry confidence intervals and are never treated as population-unbiased samples without correction
Fetched artifacts record fetch timestamps and content hashes (fetch_log)
crossDomainInteractions: Consumed by research-and-theory (compute_with_data.py) and by computational notebooks

nodes.name: Workspace Data Refresh Loop
nodes.summary: The scheduled refresh-data.sh loop: download new catalog snapshots, process them into derived CSVs, rebuild dashboards and figures, and update the reports.

nodes.name: trigger-orchestrator
nodes.summary: refresh-data.sh is invoked by cron/heartbeat or the /astro-refresh-data command; the orchestrator coordinates the sweep.

nodes.name: refresh-gwtc-snapshot
nodes.summary: update_gwosc_gwtc5.py re-downloads the full GWOSC GWTC-1..GWTC-5 catalog (391 events) writing raw JSON, tidy CSV, and catalog stats with fetch timestamps.

nodes.name: refresh-heasarc-blackcat
nodes.summary: download_heasarc.py and download_blackcat.py fetch HEASARC TAP tables and the published BlackCAT dynamical VizieR sample.

nodes.name: process-blackcat
nodes.summary: process_blackcat.py parses and joins the VizieR tables into data/processed/blackcat_dynamical.csv, keeping limits as limits.

nodes.name: augment-derived-quantities
nodes.summary: add_bh_derived_quantities.py attaches astropy-derived SI quantities (ISCO, Hawking temperature) to the remnant/AGN catalogs without altering source values.

nodes.name: rebuild-dashboards
nodes.summary: The three dashboard builders (build_gwtc_remnant_dashboard.py, build_agn_reverberation_dashboard.py, build_blackcat_dashboard.py) regenerate the premium Plotly HTML figures from the processed CSVs.

nodes.name: write-reports
nodes.summary: compute_with_data.py reconciliation and refreshed catalog status update reports/gwosc_latest.md and reports/compute_data_report.md.

nodes.name: black-holes Project Snapshot Update
nodes.summary: The black-holes project's own refresh: replace the SQLite catalog snapshot with the latest GWOSC GWTC and HEASARC candidate data, then regenerate the overview figures.

nodes.name: fetch-gwtc
nodes.summary: update_gwosc.py downloads the current GWTC event list into data/black_holes.sqlite (replacing the snapshot table).

nodes.name: fetch-candidates
nodes.summary: update_heasarc_candidates.py refreshes HEASARC black-hole-candidate flags into the same database.

nodes.name: regenerate-figures
nodes.summary: Total-mass and SNR figures are regenerated from the refreshed catalog.

nodes.name: log-fetch
nodes.summary: The fetch_log table records the run so historical versions can be traced (back up the DB first).

nodes.name: Strain & Waveform Acquisition
nodes.summary: On-demand acquisition of large waveform assets: GWOSC O4 strain HDF5s, marquee-event strain files, and SXS numerical-relativity waveforms — stored out of the graph as heavy binaries.

nodes.name: download-marquee-events
nodes.summary: download_strain_marquee.py fetches 4 kHz 4096 s strain for GW170817, GW190814, GW190521 with SHA-verified filenames.

nodes.name: download-o4-strain
nodes.summary: download_gwosc_o4.py filters O4 events and pulls event metadata plus strain HDF5 files from GWOSC.

nodes.name: build-sxs-waveforms
nodes.summary: download_sxs.py builds the SXS waveform catalog metadata and generates synthetic NPZ waveforms where the JS-only catalog blocks direct download.

nodes.name: Notebook Health
nodes.summary: Keeps the 24 flagship notebooks executable and reproducible: executes every notebook in order on the workspace venv, collects failures, fixes the root cause (never just the symptom), and writes a health report.

businessRules: Notebooks must run top-to-bottom with the workspace .venv
Fixes target root causes, not symptoms
crossDomainInteractions: Notebooks consume the refreshed catalogs from Observational Data Refresh

nodes.name: Execute & Repair Notebook Suite
nodes.summary: notebook-health.sh executes all notebooks, collects failures, and drives root-cause fixes until the suite is green.

nodes.name: discover-notebooks
nodes.summary: notebook-health.sh enumerates every .ipynb under the project notebook directories in numbered order.

nodes.name: execute-suite
nodes.summary: Each notebook is executed end-to-end with the workspace Python venv.

nodes.name: collect-failures
nodes.summary: Errors and outputs are collected into a failures list with the failing cell context.

nodes.name: fix-root-causes
nodes.summary: The agent fixes the underlying cause (imports, data paths, API drift) and re-executes only then.

nodes.name: write-report
nodes.summary: notebook_health_report is written summarizing pass/fail state per notebook.

nodes.name: Research & Theory
nodes.summary: The scientific production domain: hypothesis-driven research loops, symbolic derivation of new formulas with verification, physics computation against the refreshed catalogs, and theory documentation for the premium site.

businessRules: Every result must state assumptions and data source
Derived quantities are labeled model-derived (e.g. Hawking temperature)
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes refreshed catalogs from Observational Data Refresh; outputs feed the published premium site

nodes.name: Research Loop
nodes.summary: research-loop.sh runs one hypothesis cycle: workspace directory, hypothesis template, symbolic/numeric derivation, figure, report, then a theory document.

nodes.name: register-hypothesis
nodes.summary: research-loop.sh creates a dated research work directory with a hypothesis template.

nodes.name: derive-symbolically
nodes.summary: The astro-theoretician agent derives the target formula symbolically, ideally extending models/derivations.py with checked Sympy steps.

nodes.name: validate-formulas
nodes.summary: verify_formulas.py asserts every symbolic check and performs numeric spot checks before results are trusted.

nodes.name: produce-figure
nodes.summary: A reproducible figure or dashboard summarizing the result is generated with Plotly/matplotlib.

nodes.name: write-theory-doc
nodes.summary: The hypothesis, derivation, caveats, and data source are written into a premium theory markdown document.

nodes.name: Formula Verification Sweep
nodes.summary: Standalone verification sweep over the whole formula inventory: run_all() derivations plus astropy/scipy numeric checks, producing the derivation report and check JSON.

nodes.name: execute-derivations
nodes.summary: models/derivations.run_all() executes each symbolic derivation, requiring every check to reduce to an identity or true boolean.

nodes.name: numeric-spot-checks
nodes.summary: Closed forms are numerically validated against astropy/scipy precise integrals.

nodes.name: write-verification-report
nodes.summary: reports/derivations_report.md and results/derivation_checks.json are written with PASS per derivation.

nodes.name: Compute Physics With Catalog Data
nodes.summary: compute_with_data.py computes physics on real data: GWTC reconciliation (chirp masses, redshifts), remnant ISCO/Hawking physics, mass-gap candidate extraction, strain quicklooks, and SXS characterization.

nodes.name: reconcile-gwtc
nodes.summary: Recomputes chirp mass from (m1,m2) and redshift from luminosity distance for 391 GWTC events, quantifying median deviation vs catalog values.

nodes.name: extract-mass-gap-candidates
nodes.summary: Flags events with 2.5 < m2 < 5 Msun into results/gwtc_mass_gap_candidates.csv.

nodes.name: remnant-radiation-physics
nodes.summary: Computes ISCO radius and Hawking temperature for events with final mass into results/gwtc_remnant_isco_hawking.csv.

nodes.name: strain-quicklook
nodes.summary: Band-power chirp detection quicklooks on the three marquee strain files with per-detector peak timing.

nodes.name: write-compute-report
nodes.summary: Summarizes all blocks into reports/compute_data_report.md with UTC generation stamps.

nodes.name: Knowledge Graph Maintenance
nodes.summary: Keeps the three Understand-Anything graphs current: the merged code graph (root + exotic-compact-objects subdomain), the domain flow graph, and the wiki knowledge graph. A deterministic drift loop compares the working tree against committed fingerprints and queues the exact /understand work before an agent refresh.

businessRules: The nested exotic-compact-objects repo is analyzed as its own subdomain graph and merged, never inside the root scan
Incremental updates re-analyze only changed files by default
crossDomainInteractions: Graphs are refreshed after each Observational Data Refresh sweep

nodes.name: Code Graph Refresh & Subdomain Merge
nodes.summary: Refresh the merged code graph: scan/analyze the workspace root, analyze the nested flagship repo as a subdomain, and merge the two graphs with the bundled merge script.

nodes.name: scan-workspace
nodes.summary: scan-project.mjs enumerates root files under .ua/.understandignore rules, excluding the nested repo.

nodes.name: analyze-nested-repo
nodes.summary: The exotic-compact-objects repo is scanned separately (code without data) to produce its own nodes and edges.

nodes.name: merge-subdomain
nodes.summary: merge-subdomain-graphs.py merges the subdomain graph into .ua/knowledge-graph.json with dedup and a merge report.

nodes.name: Domain & Wiki Graph Refresh
nodes.summary: Refresh the domain flow graph and the wiki knowledge graph so domain views and the Karpathy-wiki entity/claim graph track the code and prose.

nodes.name: derive-domain-graph
nodes.summary: The domain analyzer derives domains/flows/steps from the merged code graph and saves domain-graph.json.

nodes.name: parse-wiki
nodes.summary: parse-knowledge-base.py scans research/wiki (17 pages, 144 wikilinks) into a scan manifest.

nodes.name: merge-wiki-graph
nodes.summary: The knowledge merge assembles article/entity/topic nodes with wikilink and implicit edges and saves the wiki knowledge graph.

nodes.name: Graph Drift Check & Work Queue
nodes.summary: The deterministic refresh-graphs.sh loop: scan the root and subdomain, compare content hashes and file lists against the committed graphs, write the exact work list to .ua/refresh-requested.json, then hand it to an agent session that runs /understand, re-applies cohesion edges, and refreshes the derived graphs.

nodes.name: scan-working-tree
nodes.summary: scan-project.mjs scans the workspace root (73 files) and the nested subdomain (84 files) with the committed ignore rules, producing deterministic inventories.

nodes.name: compare-root-fingerprints
nodes.summary: Each root file's SHA-256 content hash is compared with .ua/fingerprints.json to classify added, changed, and removed files.

nodes.name: compare-subdomain-files
nodes.summary: The subdomain scan is compared against the file paths recorded in the committed subgraph, plus mtimes newer than the graph build.

nodes.name: write-refresh-request
nodes.summary: Drift is written to .ua/refresh-requested.json with root and subdomain added/changed/removed lists and explicit agent actions; no drift removes a stale request.

nodes.name: incremental-understand-refresh
nodes.summary: An agent session consumes the work list, runs /understand incrementally for the root, rebuilds and merges the subdomain graph when needed, and re-applies cohesion edges.

nodes.name: refresh-derived-graphs
nodes.summary: When content changed, /understand-domain and /understand-knowledge research/wiki regenerate the domain and wiki graphs; the cycle ends when the loop reports no drift.

edges.description: Freshly fetched GWTC/HEASARC/BlackCAT snapshots are the input data for compute_with_data.py and the notebook analyses.
Refreshed processed CSVs change notebook data paths; notebook health re-verifies executability after each sweep.
After each data sweep the orchestrator reminds to refresh the three graphs so they track catalog changes.
New theory documents and scripts from research cycles enter the code graph on the next refresh.
Notebook repair often propagates import or formula changes back into the models package.
